chapter_title_en: The Blackflame Dragon in the Mist
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 111 – The Blackflame Dragon Strikes: Ji Clan’s Formation Battle
chapter_meta_description: Twelve Snowdragon Mountain Zifu Disciples enter the Ji Clan’s Blackflame Dragon Prison Formation. Four die instantly as a colossal dragon head erupts from the mist. A masterstroke of formation warfare.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 111 – Formation Warfare: The Blackflame Dragon Devours Four
og_description: A brutal ambush unfolds as the Ji Clan’s Blackflame Dragon Prison Formation shatters the enemy’s confidence. Twelve invaders become eight in seconds.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 111: The Dragon Bites
twitter_description: The Ji Clan’s formation springs its trap—two Zifu Disciples dead in a single, devastating lunge.
